title: Train with Ramps, Deploy with Ranks: code, results and preprint
description: Code, raw results and preprint for WOS-R: cascades and banks of weighted order statistic (rank-order) filters trained with a ramp relaxation and deployed as exact rank filters. Benchmarks against CNNs, MLPs and Transformers on 1D and image impulse denoising, operator coverage, radar CFAR detection and fault-tolerant federated learning, including accuracy, residual error, convergence time, latency and parameter counts. Continuation of the author's 1993 UPC thesis on adaptive cascades of order filters.
